description:
Body tired, mind restless - yet sleep won't come?

We have got you covered with the ultimate Magnesium Kit for deep sleep, stress relief, and muscle recovery!

🌿 Fact: Nearly 60% of women are Magnesium deficient, impacting sleep, stress levels, and muscle health. 

▶️ Chronic stress depletes Magnesium, leading to fatigue, anxiety, and restless sleep.

▶️ Low Magnesium levels contribute to muscle cramps, headaches, and poor recovery.

Our carefully curated Magnesium kit restores balance and relaxation for your body and mind:

1️⃣ 10% Magnesium Lotion 300ml – Fast-absorbing topical solution to relax muscles, and ease tension via transdermal absorption

2️⃣ Magnesium Gummies 60N – Formulated with 5 forms of Magnesium to improve sleep quality, and reduce stress.

✅ Fortified with Vitamin B6, D3 & B9 

✅ 100% Natural

✅ Non-habit forming 

✅ No added sugar

Your daily dose of relaxation and well-being—naturally! ✨"

Magnesium Gummies:

Take one gummy post meal, 1-2 hours before bed. 
 

Magnesium Lotion:

Step 1: Take 3-4 pumps of the product in your palms.

Step 2: Disperse product across feet, soles, legs, arms, neck, shoulder and massage it in for a few seconds for full absorption.

Use post a heavy workout or before bed.

faqs.question: If there is no sugar, how is it sweet?
faqs.answer: The sweetness comes from natural prebiotic fibre called chicory root. It also has very low (near zero) glycemic index & causes no glucose spikes. Chicory also is good for gut.

faqs.question: Are there any artificial additives?
faqs.answer: No. The base of this gummy is made of a natural prebiotic fibre called chicory root. The colour comes from natural black carrot extract & the flavour comes from natural mixed berry extract. There are no artificial fillers, preservatives added.

faqs.question: Can I use this Gummy every day?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend using these gummies every day.

faqs.question: Are these gummies safe for everyone?
faqs.answer: These gummies are generally safe for everyone to consume. But if you have a critical health condition, or if you are pregnant, then we recommend speaking to a healthcare professional.

faqs.question: Can Magnesium help with anxiety and stress?
faqs.answer: Yes, Magnesium is an essential micronutrient, getting enough of which helps reduce stress and anxiety by balancing neurotransmitter levels and lowering stress hormones. Additionally, it also helps with muscle cramps/pain relief & aids in 300+ biochemical reactions in the body.

faqs.question: Are there any side effects of taking Magnesium?
faqs.answer: Magnesium is generally well-tolerated when taken as directed. Our gummies combine five forms of magnesium with vitamins B6, D3, and B9 for optimal absorption and efficacy, while being 100% natural and free from added sugar. Adhering to the recommended serving ensures safe use. For individuals with specific health conditions or on medication, consulting a healthcare professional is advised.

faqs.question: Can I take Magnesium gummies along with other supplements, like Biotin?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can. Magnesium also supports the function of other vitamins and minerals.

faqs.question: Are there any allergens in the product?
faqs.answer: Check the specific product label for allergen information, but most Magnesium Glycinate products are formulated to be free from common allergens like gluten, dairy, or soy.

faqs.question: Do I need to take a blood test before taking Magnesium?
faqs.answer: No, a blood test is generally unnecessary for healthy adults who wish to take magnesium supplements at recommended doses unless symptoms or certain medical conditions suggest an imbalance.
